mapper.insert: INSERT INTO moderation_action (target_type, target_id, action_type, operator_id, reason, rule_basis, duration_days, effective_from, effective_to, related_report_id) VALUES (#{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{actionType}, #{operatorId}, #{reason}, #{ruleBasis}, #{durationDays}, #{effectiveFrom}, #{effectiveTo}, #{relatedReportId})
mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.target_type, a.target_id, a.action_type, a.reason, a.rule_basis, a.duration_days, u.nickname AS operator_name, a.effective_from, a.effective_to, a.created_at FROM moderation_action a JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = a.operator_id WHERE a.target_type = #{targetType} AND a.target_id = #{targetId} ORDER BY a.id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM moderation_action WHERE created_at >= #{from} AND created_at < #{to}
SELECT action_type AS action_type, COUNT(*) AS count FROM moderation_action WHERE created_at >= #{from} AND created_at < #{to} GROUP BY action_type
